title: HostIndexDocumentDeletedPayload
description: host.index_document.deleted v1 (OpenVibe.Host server/catalog/search-index.js, via openvibe-publishing/search-feed). A Search tombstone for a hosting catalog page (a plan or a provider) that is hidden, gone or deleted. Only sent for a page Search was sent before, and only when the tombstone's revision moved. Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type: plan|provider, id, revision }, visibility internal, actor service:host.

revision.description: Index revision of the tombstone; wins over any document at the same or an older revision.
